checks.title: Generated graph uses an unexpected modelling pattern
checks.description: A value is attached directly to an entity where the agreed pattern puts it on an intermediate node. The triple is valid and the number is right; what is lost is everywhere the unit and quantity kind would have gone.
checks.remediation: Build the intermediate node the pattern calls for, and move the value onto it.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Values are attached the way the agreed pattern attaches them
